productByIdentifier.title: Japandi Stoel
productByIdentifier.descriptionHtml:
The Japandi Chair is designed to strike a perfect balance between simplicity and comfort. Inspired by the harmony of Japanese and Scandinavian design, it features a clean silhouette with soft curves and a supportive seat that works in both relaxed and refined interiors.Instead of a solid wood frame, the Japandi Chair uses an iron base with a wood-effect finish. This choice makes the chair stronger, more affordable, and visually just as warm. You can hardly tell the difference unless you touch it, which makes it a smart and sustainable solution for everyday use.The materials are selected for their durability and timeless appeal. The design fits effortlessly around dining tables, in a reading nook, or even as an occasional chair in the bedroom or hallway. Its clean lines and balanced proportions blend naturally into interiors where calm and function matter.At Pole to Pole we value honest materials and thoughtful design. The Japandi Chair delivers just that — a stylish seat that brings atmosphere and usability together, without compromise.
